backend/main.mo: Main backend canister implementing order creation, profile management, access control, and blob-storage integration with admin/user permission checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that maps old actor state to a new state format, preserving orders and profiles while initializing the updated state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, associated files, components, and test IDs for verification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file, including components, pages, hooks, and theming behaviors.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment configuration showing how to set backend canister ID and Internet Identity URL for local and production development.
frontend/.env.production: Production environment template requiring injected canister ID and defining Internet Identity URL for deployed builds.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining prerequisites, admin setup, and steps for deploying the app to the Internet Computer mainnet.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration defining color variables and theming rules for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file loading fonts, icons, and mounting the frontend application entrypoint.
frontend/scripts/deploy-mainnet.sh: Automates mainnet deployment by validating environment, building the frontend, deploying via dfx, and verifying canister IDs.
frontend/scripts/validate-production-env: Checks that required production environment variables and dfx configuration are valid before deployment.
frontend/src/@types/html2canvas.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file placeholder for html2canvas.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the main app router, route components, authentication redirects, and theme provider setup.
frontend/src/components/AdminGate.tsx: Restricts access to child components based on admin status, showing loading or denial screens as needed.
frontend/src/components/AdminThemeLayout: Wraps admin pages in a themed layout with background effects.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Overall application layout including header, footer, disclaimer banner, and main content container.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Protects routes by requiring authentication, displaying loading or sign‑in prompts when necessary.
frontend/src/components/AuthRequiredScre: Displays an Internet Identity sign‑in screen when authentication is required.
frontend/src/components/AuthStatusButton: Provides a sign‑in/sign‑out button with Internet Identity, handling login state and navigation.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Renders the top navigation bar with logo, navigation links, admin indicator, and auth button.
frontend/src/components/IdCardActions.ts: Provides buttons to export or print an ID card using utility functions.
frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.ts: Renders a styled preview of an ID card including personal details, photo, and visual effects.
frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx: Renders a centered watermark marking content as novelty and not valid identification.
frontend/src/components/NoveltyDisclaime: Displays a banner warning that the product is for novelty use only and not real identification.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCropModal.t: Provides a modal for cropping an uploaded image to a fixed ID photo aspect ratio with drag and zoom controls.
frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Handles image file selection via drag‑and‑drop or file picker with validation and preview support.
frontend/src/components/StateSeal.tsx: Shows a state seal image or a fallback icon if unavailable.
frontend/src/constants/usStates.ts: Exports a list of U.S. states with codes and names.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Contains static disclaimer and UI copy strings related to novelty identification.
frontend/src/hooks/admin/useAdminResetAl: Mutation hook that resets backend data and clears local stored order mappings, then invalidates queries.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useIsAdmin.ts: Checks whether the current authenticated user is an admin using a cached query.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/queryKeys.ts: Defines React Query keys for order and auth‑related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useAllOrders.t: Fetches all orders for admin users with error handling for unauthorized access.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useCreateOrder: Creates a new order and stores its ID in localStorage for the current user.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useDeleteOrder: Deletes an order and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useGetOrder.ts: Retrieves a single order by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useSetTracking: Updates an order's tracking number and refreshes order data.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useUpdateOrder: Updates an order's status and invalidates order queries.
Fetches the current user's orders based on IDs stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on authentication state and triggers query invalidation on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity auth, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom themes, including chrome, gothic, and cyber admin color variables plus utility classes and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin interface for viewing, filtering, sorting, and managing all orders, including status updates, tracking numbers, deletions, and data reset.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays a user's orders with statuses and navigation to create or view orders, showing loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero content, marketing sections, and a flow overview leading users to sign in and start ordering.
frontend/src/pages/NewOrderPage.tsx: Form page for creating a new order, collecting ID details, shipping info, and a cropped photo before submitting via createOrder.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific order, including status, ID info, and a rendered photo blob.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Sign-in screen using Internet Identity, handling login state and redirecting authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: Explains Internet Identity features and routes users to the sign-in process.
frontend/src/utils/exportIdCard.ts: Exports or prints the ID card by rendering the preview element into a PNG or print window.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides formatting helpers for order status strings and bigint timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/generateIdNumber.ts: Generates a random 8‑digit numeric ID string.
frontend/src/utils/stateSeals.ts: Returns the PNG path for a state's seal based on its name.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with dark mode, content paths, container settings, and extensive custom color palettes and theme extensions for UI styling.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, including feature requirements, known issues, and pending admin-related improvements for an e‑commerce/admin system.
